source_tags.wheelchair:description: Unisex Accessible toilets via RADAR key as well as (?inaccessible for wheelchair users) separate ladies / gents. NO Changing Places toilet.
Small (often locked) accessible unisex toilet. Key available from customer services. Access carpark downstairs via stairs, lift or long ramp
Fully accessible shopping centre. Multiple entrances. Some shops have upper floor usually accessible by lift inside shop. Toilets are separate.
